title: Record review action completion id_sources omit the existing action register read
actual: The report bundle says action_id for completion comes only from POST /quality/record-reviews/{cycle_id}/actions. GET /quality/actions?source=RecordReview returns that ID and version for existing actions, including after reload.
expected: List GET /quality/actions with source=RecordReview as an action_id source for opening and completing existing actions, in both report and Owner overview bundles.
steps: As demo.quality read the register filtered by source=RecordReview and compare the row ID and version with the bundle's action_id sources.
evidence: DEV 2026-11-09T17:10:47.430848+00:00. The existing register returned action 17 and version 2, 200 request d4555aa3eb1e4ee6a473d40589562e2c. Native completion used the selected action register row (ff3f3a0a068c44858181e568066f7b9d). No live endpoint failure.
